name: Ayaqua
body:
Ayaqua CR 5

XP 1,600
CE Large humanoid (giant)
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 9, flat-footed 19 (+4 armor, +1 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size)
hp 60 (8d8+24)
Fort +6, Ref +0, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. base)
Melee greatclub +12 (2d8+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 25; Dex 12; Con 15; Int 4; Wis 10; Cha 7
Base Atk +5; CMB +11; CMD 20
Feats Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Climb +9, Perception +10
Languages Giant
SQ immune to sleep

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

Ayaqua are immune to sleep-type magic.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or cold hills or caverns
Organization solitary, pair, or part of an ogre family (3-16)
Treasure standard (hide armor, greatclub, other treasure)

Legends abound of ayaqua. These rare abominations embody the cruelest aspects of the ogre life, and are even less intelligent than even an average, single-headed ogre. These tri-headed ogres serve as barbaric troops and family mascots, and are treated almost like a favorite animal within ogre families. Rarely does an ayaqua have any say in tribal politics.

Typically, only the center head will be fully functioning and able to speak. The additional heads serve as extra sensory apparatus: the eyes and ears are functional, but there is no mental activity within these auxiliary heads.

Instead, these additional heads give the ayaqua a watchdog aspect, as even while the main head is asleep the extra heads will be awake and vigilant.

A typical adult ayaqua stands 11 feet tall and weighs roughly 900 pounds.
